verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents Automations that schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times. Each run creates a chat and executes through the normal chat completion pipeline (docs-5, docs-53). The Computer ecosystem adds scheduled tasks such as running test suites on a weekday schedule and reporting failures (docs-14, docs-31), and a personal webhook can notify users when long-running tasks finish (docs-48). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that background automations run reliably, and evidence of event-driven (non-schedule) triggers.
